title: Cyber Defenders Unit 6 · The Defender's toolkit (3-5)

items.q: What does an update really do to a game or tablet?
choices: It patches holes that tricksters could climb through
It changes your passphrase for you
items.why: An update patches holes that tricksters could climb through. It does not change your brightness, backups or passphrase.

items.q: Your tablet breaks and will not switch on. Which layer saves your photos?
choices: A backup copy kept somewhere else
items.why: A broken tablet takes its own copies with it. Only a backup kept somewhere else still has your photos.

items.q: Why can two ordinary layers together beat one strong lock?
choices: Two locks look nicer on a door
A trick must be lucky twice
If one layer slips, the second still guards you
Strong locks are against the rules
items.why: Layers back each other up: if one slips, the next still guards you. That is why two ordinary layers beat one lock.

items.q: Where do a game's rules for what may be posted live?
choices: In its agreement, which every player accepts
items.why: A game's rules for what may be posted are written in its agreement, which every player accepts when they join.

items.q: You draw a picture and a site shares it as its own. What protects your work?
choices: The law, which says the drawing is yours
items.why: The law says the drawing is yours because you made it. A site cannot take it as its own.

items.q: Someone keeps breaking the chat rules against you, week after week. What should you do?
choices: Tell a trusted adult; a rule broken against you is a reason to tell
items.why: A rule broken against you is never yours to fix alone, and breaking rules back makes it worse. Tell a trusted adult.

items.q: What are the five Defender moves, in order?
choices: Share it, reply, delete, hide, forget
Stop, save it, tell an adult, block or report, carry on
items.why: The five moves go stop, save it, tell an adult, block or report, carry on. The other lists spread the trouble or skip help.

items.q: Why does saving a horrid message help instead of deleting it in a panic?
choices: It is proof an adult can act on
It does not help at all
items.why: A saved message is proof a trusted adult can act on. Deleting it in a panic throws the proof away.

items.q: You typed your mailbox key into a fake page by mistake. What are your best next moves?
choices: Tell a trusted adult fast, so the key can be changed
Wait a month to see what happens
items.why: A key typed into a fake page must be changed fast. A trusted adult can help change it before anyone uses it.

items.q: A letter promises a huge prize if you tap its button right now. Which trained skill spots it?
choices: Routing a packet across the map
Spotting trick clues: hurry and a prize you never entered for
items.why: Hurry plus a prize you never entered for are trick clues, trained in Unit 4. Routing, passphrases and sorting are other skills.

items.q: Two messages claim to be from Pim. One mentions a private fact only the real post office would handle carefully. What helps you judge?
choices: The message with the most colors
Footprint clues: what each message knows and how it asks
Ask the Magpie which is real
items.why: Footprint clues decide it: what each message knows, and how it asks. Colors, order or the Magpie's word prove nothing.

items.q: The Sealed Note lock needs a code only the key holder can read. Which unit trained that skill?
items.why: Codes that only the key holder can read were trained in Unit 2, keys and secret codes.
